create.name: Donnabelle Casis
create.bio:
Donnabelle Casis is a medium, Reiki teacher and intuitive mentor based in Easthampton, in western Massachusetts, who works under the name Sonorous Light. She says she sensed spirit presences from childhood, and her path into this work opened after she brought through an unexpected message for a friend. She has since passed the Forever Family Foundation's controlled evaluation as both an evidential and a trance medium, and holds master-teacher levels in Usui/Tibetan and Holy Fire III Karuna Reiki, with further training in sound work and biofield tuning.

Most of her sessions are one to one, in her Easthampton studio or online: mediumship readings that aim to bring specific, checkable details from people who have died, aura readings in which she sketches the colours she perceives onto a card, and three-month mentorships for people developing their own intuitive abilities. She teaches intuition and mediumship workshops at Omega Institute and joins its Reiki and mediumship weekends. Alongside this she is a working visual artist and curator, presents an arts programme on local radio, and hosts To Hum is Human, a podcast of conversations about intuition and purpose.

videos.title: Donnabelle Casis - To Hum is Human: Lessons in Listening. Answers to the Call.

courses.title: The Wisdom of Reiki Conference
courses.description: A weekend at Omega's Rhinebeck campus where she teaches alongside William Lee Rand and five other Reiki teachers. The programme combines talks on Reiki's history, hands-on practice, energy sessions and a shamanic journey, and is open to newcomers as well as masters.

courses.title: Mediumship Reading
courses.description: A private session, in person or online, in which she seeks to make contact with people who have died and pass on details and messages for the sitter to recognise. Sessions run for half an hour or just under an hour.

courses.title: Psychic Auracle Reading
courses.description: An intuitive reading of the energy field around the body, in which she draws the colours she perceives onto a small card for the client to keep and explains what each may say about past, present and possible future. Coloured ribbons can be used to focus on a particular question.

courses.title: 1:1 Mentorships
courses.description: A one-to-one mentoring programme over roughly three months for people who want to develop their intuitive and spiritual gifts and build confidence in them. It starts with a free half-hour video call to talk through goals; this first call is not a reading.
